title: Move unadmitted declared-artifact judging off the runtime event reader
outcome: Adopted-turn declared-test completion reuses the existing counted capture owner so declaration/artifact/Git reads do not hold up runtime event consumption, while retaining exact observation identity and artifact semantics.
acceptance: Use the existing capture lifecycle for declared verdict work, preserving exact start binding, one observed occurrence and truthful unknown/mismatch handling without adding a parallel worker owner.
A NotFinished launch avoids needless artifact judging, and relevant deterministic reader-progress/outcome coverage plus the standard review/gate validates the minimal change.
